_doc: free-exercise-db muscle vocabulary -> canonical JCV muscle regions.
Source vocabulary: https://github.com/yuhonas/free-exercise-db (Unlicense / public domain, JSON metadata only).
CANONICAL VOCABULARY: the region ids on the right are the SAME ids the 2D SVG atlas uses
build_scene.py bakes as JCV_<region> vertex groups — one exercise definition drives the
Approximations (mirroring the atlas's muscle-map.ts, on purpose):
abductors   -> glutes  gluteus medius/minimus are the main hip abductors
middle back -> lats    rhomboid/mid-trap region; single upper-back shape in both systems
null = no honest region in either system; render_exercise.py skips it with a log line:
neck - sternocleidomastoid; the atlas treats the neck as structural-only, so does the mannequin
